composition_instruction: Preserve the complete goal and adapt templates to the actual question. Distinguish a bounded sample from platform-wide coverage; disclose caps, failed routes, missing values and stale records.
Do not infer causation, sensitive attributes, verified contact ownership or live availability from advertised capability.
access_constraints: Planning only. Validate the live schema, supported authentication, source permissions and source-specific limits.
Present exact inputs, limits, current price/usage and total spending cap; obtain bounded approval before any paid collection.
Use public data or user-authorized supported access; never bypass login, membership, private-source restrictions or rate limits.
